name: Waiting for a Girl Like You

podcast.body: This song famously spent nine weeks stuck at the number two spot on the charts, blocked from reaching number one by Olivia Newton-John's dominant hit "Physical." "For nine weeks, foreigners waiting for a girl like you hung out at the number two spot blocked by physical."

This power ballad, the meticulous follow-up single to "Urgent," featured Lou Gramm's aching vocal complementing dreamy keyboards played and arranged by session player Thomas Dolby, whose career Mut effectively launched. It spent ten weeks stuck at number two on the Hot 100, parked behind Olivia Newton-John's "Physical" and Darryl Hall and John Oates' "I Can't Go For That," setting a Hot 100 record for the longest-running number two hit without ever reaching number one (tied with Missy Elliott's "Work It"). "Waiting for a girl like you was heartbreaking in more ways than one."
